class: A test in the domain suite (`tests/`, standard library + domain package only) that imports the application package runs the application's import-time side effects - here the W-024 root log redaction - inside the shared test process, so later, unrelated tests in the same run see altered global state (log records without exc_info) and fail only in the combined order CI uses, never when run alone.
mechanism: W-067 round 2 added tests/history/test_finalize_completeness.py with `from ofo_app.history_finalize import ...`; importing ofo_app installed the root redaction; tests/execution/test_safety_checks.py:640 (`assert any(r.exc_info for r in caplog.records)`) then failed in CI's lint-and-test job.

first_seen.evidence: local: tests/execution/test_safety_checks.py alone 168 passed; tests/history + test_safety_checks.py in one process on the branch 1 failed / 238 passed, on main 227 passed; per-file bisection: only test_finalize_completeness.py + test_safety_checks.py fails; that file's only app import is ofo_app.history_finalize.

fix: W-067 round 3: app-dependent tests move to tests_app/; a repo-wide ast guard test fails on any `import ofo_app` / `from ofo_app` statement under tests/ (string mentions allowed), with a self-test.

detection.note: Becomes guarded when the W-067 round-3 guard test (tests/test_no_app_imports.py) merges.

occurrences.evidence: CI lint-and-test red on an unrelated execution-safety test
